name: Massey University
story: Massey taught and researched GIS adoption, spatial information and web delivery. James Maguire’s 1999 JavaGenasys thesis described an early approach to browser mapping using specialised software components.

Sheryl Denise Hendriksen’s 1995 soil-science thesis used GIS to analyse East Coast erosion following Cyclone Bola. Massey also hosted Harmsworth’s 1996 GIS and Māori land-values workshop contribution.
